origin.xyloniaorigins.elf.name: Elf
origin.xyloniaorigins.elf.description: The elf are the species that was the first to found magic. And they are extremly respectfull of the nature, this is why they are all vegetarian
origin.xyloniaorigins.goliath.name: Goliath
origin.xyloniaorigins.goliath.descriptio: The goliath are a specie that is not famous for their knowledge in the arcane. Instead they had developed the greatest strenght of all the species that live in this world. This strengh need a lot of energy that they produce by eating exclusly meat
origin.xyloniaorigins.dwarf.name: Dwarf
origin.xyloniaorigins.dwarf.description: The dwarf is a litle but still robust specie, they are great worker and mine block faster
origin.xyloniaorigins.goblin.name: Goblin
origin.xyloniaorigins.goblin.description: The goblin is weak with 2 hearth less than human and is small, like really small an average goblin measure 1m high so all the world seam really big to a goblin perspective. But this tiny size come with the pro to run faster than any other species and also jump higher.
power.xyloniaorigins.tall.name: Tall
power.xyloniaorigins.tall.description: Your specie is slightly taller than human
power.xyloniaorigins.giant.name: Giant
power.xyloniaorigins.giant.description: Your specie is giant, your height are 3 block tall so 1 meter more than a regular human
power.xyloniaorigins.small.name: Small
power.xyloniaorigins.small.description: Your specie is smaller than a human approximatly one block and half a block tall.
power.xyloniaorigins.tiny.name: Tiny
power.xyloniaorigins.tiny.description: Your specie is the smallest specie and measure only one block tall
The damage of distance weapon are increased
power.xyloniaorigins.mining_expertise.de: You have strong arms that allow you to break block one half faster than a human
power.xyloniaorigins.true_strength.name: True strength
power.xyloniaorigins.true_strength.descr: You are two times stronger than any other species in closed combat
power.xyloniaorigins.agility_jump.name: Lightweight
power.xyloniaorigins.agility_jump.descri: Your specie is lightweight that let it manage to jump 1 bloc high
power.xyloniaorigins.agility_speed.name: Run faster
power.xyloniaorigins.agility_speed.descr: Your specie run two times faster than an ordinary human
power.xyloniaorigins.extra_health.name: More health
power.xyloniaorigins.extra_health.descri: Your specie have 4 more health hearth than a human
power.xyloniaorigins.less_health.name: Less health
power.xyloniaorigins.less_health.descrip: Your specie have less health than other, two hearth less than human
power.xyloniaorigins.increased_exhaustio: You have a bigger appetite, your hunger are approximatly two times more than a human
power.xyloniaorigins.max_mana.name: Arcane master
power.xyloniaorigins.max_mana.descriptio: You have a two times more mana than a basic human
power.xyloniaorigins.min_mana.name: Dumb
power.xyloniaorigins.min_mana.descriptio: You are the dumbest species out there, your mana is two times less than a human
power.xyloniaorigins.slow.name: Short legs
power.xyloniaorigins.slow.description: Your specie have short legs so they walk slower
